areas_label_present.name: areas_label_present
areas_label_present.value: "areas"."system_key" is not null or "areas"."name" is not null

projects_dates_ordered.name: projects_dates_ordered
projects_dates_ordered.value: "projects"."start_date" is null or "projects"."target_date" is null or "projects"."start_date" <= "projects"."target_date"

task_statuses_label_present.name: task_statuses_label_present
task_statuses_label_present.value: "task_statuses"."system_key" is not null or "task_statuses"."name" is not null

tasks_subtasks_have_no_project.name: tasks_subtasks_have_no_project
tasks_subtasks_have_no_project.value: "tasks"."parent_task_id" is null or ("tasks"."project_id" is null and "tasks"."milestone_id" is null)

tasks_milestone_needs_project.name: tasks_milestone_needs_project
tasks_milestone_needs_project.value: "tasks"."milestone_id" is null or "tasks"."project_id" is not null

tasks_due_time_needs_date.name: tasks_due_time_needs_date
tasks_due_time_needs_date.value: "tasks"."due_time" is null or "tasks"."due_date" is not null

development_attributes_discipline_fixed.name: development_attributes_discipline_fixed
development_attributes_discipline_fixed.value: "development_attributes"."system_key" is distinct from 'discipline' or ("development_attributes"."name" is null and "development_attributes"."archived_at" is null)

xp_ledger_kind_shape.name: xp_ledger_kind_shape
xp_ledger_kind_shape.value: ("xp_ledger"."kind" = 'grant' and "xp_ledger"."amount" > 0 and "xp_ledger"."reversal_of" is null) or ("xp_ledger"."kind" = 'reversal' and "xp_ledger"."amount" < 0 and "xp_ledger"."reversal_of" is not null)

reward_ledger_title_present.name: reward_ledger_title_present
reward_ledger_title_present.value: "reward_ledger"."title" is not null or "reward_ledger"."title_key" is not null

reward_ledger_kind_shape.name: reward_ledger_kind_shape
reward_ledger_kind_shape.value:
("reward_ledger"."kind" = 'reward_redeemed' and "reward_ledger"."reward_id" is not null and "reward_ledger"."active_xp_spent" >= 0 and "reward_ledger"."level_xp_spent" >= 0 and "reward_ledger"."active_xp_spent" + "reward_ledger"."level_xp_spent" > 0)
       or ("reward_ledger"."kind" = 'reward_refunded' and "reward_ledger"."refund_of" is not null and "reward_ledger"."active_xp_spent" <= 0 and "reward_ledger"."level_xp_spent" <= 0)
       or ("reward_ledger"."kind" = 'milestone_reward_claimed' and "reward_ledger"."level_reward_id" is not null and "reward_ledger"."active_xp_spent" = 0 and "reward_ledger"."level_xp_spent" >= 0 and ("reward_ledger"."early" or "reward_ledger"."level_xp_spent" = 0))

finance_accounts_category_shape.name: finance_accounts_category_shape
finance_accounts_category_shape.value:
("finance_accounts"."kind" = 'asset' and "finance_accounts"."asset_category" in ('cash', 'bank_deposit', 'ewallet', 'savings', 'investment', 'other'))
       or ("finance_accounts"."kind" = 'liability' and "finance_accounts"."asset_category" is null)

finance_accounts_closed_only_archived.name: finance_accounts_closed_only_archived
finance_accounts_closed_only_archived.value: "finance_accounts"."closed_on" is null or "finance_accounts"."archived_at" is not null

finance_snapshots_valuation_shape.name: finance_snapshots_valuation_shape
finance_snapshots_valuation_shape.value:
("finance_snapshots"."fx_rate" is null and "finance_snapshots"."fx_source" is null and "finance_snapshots"."base_amount" is null)
       or ("finance_snapshots"."fx_rate" is not null and "finance_snapshots"."fx_source" in ('identity', 'manual') and "finance_snapshots"."base_amount" is not null)
